How to read this benchmark

Results measure agreement with source labels reviewed for this collection, not expert-validated botanical accuracy. Correct means an untied first candidate with usable flower evidence. Review-required acceptance is separate and remains disabled.

Strict top-three counts an expected candidate only when its entire score-tie group fits within three places. Tie-inclusive top-three also includes a candidate tied across that boundary. Errors and unresolved results stay in the denominator.

Masks are for visual inspection; mask accuracy has not been annotated. Leaf evidence can weakly separate flower near-ties. Reserved photographs are not processed in the default run. Related captures are grouped conservatively by source author within each flower group.

Re-run from the project with npm run benchmark. This saves an immutable result snapshot and mask images. Use npm run benchmark -- --split reserved only when ready to expose the reserved set, then publish the new report.
